description: Longest-first start order for the client integration matrix (Cratis/Chronicle#5875). GitHub starts matrix jobs in include order, so the slowest shards must start first or they become the tail of the run.
derivation: Slowest job in seconds per '<namespace>|<shard>' from the hosted run 43378627600 (all-provider dispatch, attempt 1, branch ci-4765-lane-budget). Job names truncate the mode and database, so the slowest of the configurations stands for the shard. Batched namespaces are not listed and start after every listed shard. for_ReadModels and for_EventStoreSubscriptions were one shard in that run and are now two; their entries are estimates (the larger-class shard keeps the old duration, the other a share of it) until a run measures them. Projections and for_EventSequence (4 shards each) and for_Imports (one shard, 540 s) were split again in #5875 into 5, 5 and 2 shards; their entries are estimates (Projections 657+624+601+597 = 2479 s over 5 = 496 s, for_EventSequence 618+565+539+536 = 2258 s over 5 = 452 s, for_Imports 320 s and 240 s) until a run measures them. Refresh from a newer run; the order is a hint, never a filter, so a stale table cannot change what runs.
